exact_statement: For every ordered Boolean gate union, physical restriction gives an exact cover with no extra gates or inner regular functions, shrinking relevant supports and inherited ranks, conditional gate probabilities p_l^a<=2^|A|p_l and explicit independent-root and label ledgers. Disjoint sign products admit the parity-of-sign cover with explicit count and product gate probabilities; fresh physical selector covers have dyadic conditional probability and incidence-scaling ledgers, while reused selectors require actual branch restriction first. For every balanced Boolean core g with complete nonempty spectral subprobability reference of cost c_g and r>=1 fresh point controls, p=2^-r, there is a full normalized vacuum-separated projected reference for F=1+A_r(g-1) with cross entropy C_F<=h2(2p-p^2)+2r(2p-p^2)+p*c_g<=p*c_g+(6+2/ln(2))*p*r. Consequently c_g<=K I(g) gives C_F<=max(K,6+2/ln(2)) I(F), stable under disjoint tensor references, fresh-character balancing and balanced-core activation, with no repeated influence charge. This is not a universal construction of the core reference or a bound on the original queue infimum. Additionally, fixing the ten active controls of the actual two-gate union A_10*(z AND (y1 OR y2)) increases each of the Section 5 worst-degree gate-label, subset-allocation and rank/rarity helper expectations, with exact parent upper bounds 5/1024,55/1024,231/1024 and child bounds 17/16,at least 1/16,3/10. This is pointwise, not an averaged obstruction. Four explicit same-physical-selector multiplexer iterations have raw cover read d+1 but reduce exactly to two gates with root probability 1/9 at weights 1/2, H=2 and I=3/2.
